meta.name: FyAgent For You Gate WorkBuddy Prototype
meta.description: R4-reviewed For You Gate visual language applied to the current WorkBuddy information architecture for prototype review only.

color.palette_type: cool analogous with restrained warm semantic accent

neutral.usage: Graphite surfaces occupy most area; warm white carries primary text; cool grays carry borders and secondary copy.

color.contrast_strategy: High-contrast warm-white text on layered graphite; blue/cyan limited to interactive focus and identity.

font_families.heading: condensed grotesk Chinese display sans, fallback Noto Sans SC
font_families.body: humanist Chinese UI sans, fallback Noto Sans SC
font_families.mono: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

typography.font_style_notes: Technical, direct, two-to-three weights; no decorative serif or generic startup display styling.

spacing.section_rhythm: Compact navigation, 24–32px panel padding, 16–24px internal grouping, 24px grid gaps.

layout.alignment_tendency: strict left-aligned grid with a two-column hero

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px cool-gray borders on panels, inputs, and selected navigation

elevation.depth_cues: surface tone, thin borders, and sparse blue/cyan luminous points

iconography.style: simple outlined functional icons plus the filled Y gate identity mark
iconography.preferred_set: existing FyAgent application marks and Lucide-style controls

components.button_style: 8px radius, high-contrast blue primary, graphite secondary, 40px desktop target
components.input_style: dark elevated field, 1px border, mono for URL/model values, clear focus ring
components.card_style: flat graphite panel with 1px border and 12px radius
components.navigation_pattern: compact horizontal app switcher with selected WorkBuddy pill
components.list_style: searchable operational list with neutral empty state
components.component_notes: Progress, connection, and model selection form one continuous task path rather than equal generic cards.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A gate that verifies entry into a connected Agent ecosystem

visual_language.whitespace_usage: controlled breathing room around the task path
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: hero identity at top, operational weight below
visual_language.focal_strategy: single Y gate identity followed by progressive task flow
visual_language.contrast_level: high for text and actions, low for decorative constellation
visual_language.texture_usage: none beyond soft graphite tonal variation

composition.hierarchy_method: scale, spatial isolation, and signal-color focus
composition.flow_direction: top-to-bottom, then left-to-right across progress, connection, selection
composition.grouping_strategy: task-stage grouping rather than generic card repetition
composition.negative_space_role: separates identity, form work, and empty model state

imagery.graphic_elements: Y gate symbol, sparse nodes, thin orbital connections

interaction_feel.feedback_style: clear border and color state changes
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: subtle signal-color emphasis without scale effects
interaction_feel.loading_style: small inline spinner only where data loads

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: state what is missing and the next action

overview.fallback_strategy: static Y mark and static constellation image

particle_systems.description: No live particles; constellation nodes are static.

3d_elements.description: The prototype intentionally avoids the reviewed Three.js model because the page needs a lightweight operational focus.

canvas_drawings.description: No canvas implementation in the prototype.

visual_effects.composite_notes: The prototype translates the approved 05 ecosystem idea into a quiet static radial diagram; it does not embed the heavy Three.js package or imply real hardware.
